### Love Your Brothers
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/love-your-brothers
Passage: 1 John 2:9-11
Points:
- Loving fellow Christians is a vital assurance that one is walking in the light rather than spiritual darkness.
- While the command to love is an ancient covenant obligation, it became new through the life and ministry of Jesus.
- Jesus revealed the ultimate depth of love by extending limitless forgiveness and laying down His life for others.
- Abiding in Christ requires extending genuine love even to brothers and sisters who are difficult to love.

### The Danger of Self-Love
Author: Michael A. Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-october-9-2025.html
Passage: 1 John 2:10
Points:
- Knowing Christ is proven not through head knowledge, but through actively walking in love.
- Self-obsession and self-focus serve as the primary fuel for hatred and resentment toward others.
- Walking in the light requires honestly examining the heart for subtle, hidden roots of bitterness.
- Believers must invite the Lord to uncover self-centeredness so His grace can overflow into love.
